caption:
Commercial cleaning businesses often win contracts requiring upfront staffing and equipment before the first invoice is paid. Working capital can bridge contract start-up costs, while equipment finance supports vehicles and machinery.

Every industry has its own rhythm when it comes to cash flow and finance needs, understanding commercial cleaning businesses's specific pattern is the first step to finding the right fit.

Winning a new contract is only step one, funding the staff and equipment to deliver it is the real cash-flow challenge.
